basic_profile.bio: I'm a 34-year-old software developer living in the suburbs of Seattle. Recently, I've decided to pick up new hobbies, and learning piano is at the top of my list. When I'm not coding or tinkering with gadgets, I enjoy exploring the Star Wars Expanded Universe and reminiscing about the good old days. I work a 9-to-5 job, which gives me evenings and weekends to dive into Reddit. I'm married, no kids, and my partner and I often bond over our mutual love for retro movies and music.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies mainly in software development, with a decent understanding of hardware due to my tech-savvy nature. I am mostly self-taught, having started programming as a teenager. My father, a retired engineer, instilled in me a love for fixing and understanding things, which has translated into various DIY projects around the house.
